review.notes: Full review of README (2636 lines) and Suggested.lean. Seeded sample (1.1, 1.4, 1.6, 1.9, 3.2, 3.4, 4.1, 5.2, 5.3, 5.4, 6.1, 6.2, 6.6, 6.8, 6.10) checked against the supplier roadmap sections they cite; the README gives no theorem/page locators into sources and no declaration locators into the formal proof, which was not read. Sources read: Announcement (author page) and Gan-Qiu-Takeda arXiv 1207.4709 (Theorems 1.3, 7.1) for constants and wording. Adversarial pass with recomputed values across Layers 0-6 (signs, weights, Satake, Rallis constants, theta-line values numerically, 6.11 example field). About 105 supplier section citations resolved; overlap read of 8 closest roadmaps. Worker's automatic checks all passed; my own gate run showed two false positives (default merge order, family-index files). Dependency check: 0 problems. Suggested.lean elaborates with no output (declares nothing); docstring library names verified at the pins. One finding: 3.2 duplicates ThetaKernelsForUnitaryDualPairs 6.13a(i) and the scope gives it two owners.
